detail.longDescription:
SayPilot is an AI reply assistant that helps you answer messages in dating chats, DMs, group conversations, and work chats. Tap the floating assistant to turn visible chat context, your reply goal, or a rough draft into natural AI reply suggestions—without leaving the conversation.

What should I reply?

Get context-aware AI message replies for one-to-one chats and supported group chats. Choose a warm, witty, playful, polite, direct, careful, or lightly flirty tone. Ask for a specific outcome, improve a draft, or compare several suggestions before you copy one.

One tap. You stay in control.

SayPilot generates replies only when you request them. It never types messages, presses Send, or takes autonomous actions. Review, edit, copy, use, or discard every suggestion yourself.

AI texting assistant for dating, DMs, friends, and work

- Dating replies and social chats: create confident, playful, respectful messages, with more charm or “rizz” when it fits.
- Friends and groups: reply to the whole group or focus on one participant.
- Work chats: make a message clearer, more professional, concise, or tactful.

Optional memory for one-to-one chats

For eligible one-to-one chats, optional memory can retain useful context and reply preferences so future suggestions better fit the conversation. Review, disable, manage, or clear memory in Settings. Group chats do not create long-term profiles.

Reply details, texting guidance, and languages

Follow the chat language automatically or choose a language. Where available, review practical guidance on each suggestion’s tone, reasoning, fit, and potential risks.

Optional screenshot recognition

If chat text cannot be read reliably, start screenshot recognition and approve Android screen capture for that session. SayPilot does not continuously record your screen. After you approve screen capture, the screenshot may be sent over HTTPS to SayPilot services and the AI provider used for that request.

Accessibility and data use

SayPilot uses Android AccessibilityService to identify supported chat screens and provide the floating assistant. While enabled, it can identify the current supported chat app, but it reads and analyzes visible chat content only after you tap the assistant.

This may include visible messages, sender names, message direction, the conversation title, and your current draft. If you request earlier context, SayPilot may briefly scroll only the current chat.

Before cloud reply generation, review the selected context and cancel if you do not want to continue. Only after you confirm may that context be sent over HTTPS to SayPilot services and the AI provider used to generate reply suggestions.

SayPilot does not monitor or upload chat text in the background, access unrelated apps, or take autonomous actions. You can skip Accessibility setup or disable the service at any time in Android Settings.

AI suggestions may be inaccurate or inappropriate. Always review them before use.
